primitives.name: Defensive Swarm Score
primitives.verbatim_quote: Swarm Score = how many defenders' influence regions "swarm" the carrier.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S_{\\text{swarm}}': 'Dimensionless swarm count', 'p_i(x,y,t)': "Defender i's spatio-temporal influence probability density", '\\tau': 'Swarm presence threshold (e.g., 0.3)', 'N': 'Total number of defending players'}
primitives.assumptions: Gaussian process assumption for defender influence regions, static swarm threshold, and perfect tracking data.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Complete loss occurs when tracker fails to identify any defender within the carrier's vicinity, rendering S_{\text{swarm}} = 0.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's stable predictive power via conformal prediction intervals on future yards after catch (YAC). Maps to GSE's situational awareness by treating S_{\text{swarm}} as a state variable in defensive coverage policies.
layer2.telemetry: Regression of future YAC allowed on Swarm Score versus prior YAC allows for validation.

primitives.name: Tackles Over Predicted
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **MATH:** Defender influence ~ N2(μ = f(position, velocity, direction), Σ); count defenders exceeding a swarm threshold vs.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'TOP_i': "Player i's Tackles Over Predicted (dimensionless)", 'J_i': 'Set of all tackle opportunities for player i', '\\delta_j': 'Binary indicator of actual tackle at opportunity j', '\\hat{\\delta}_j': 'XGBoost-predicted tackle probability at opportunity j'}
primitives.assumptions: Stationary tackle opportunity distribution, accurate physics parameter measurement, and XGBoost model calibration across seasons.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when tackle mechanics shift (e.g., rule changes) causing the training distribution to mismatch the test environment.

layer2.mapping: Serves as a foundational component for GSI's predictive metrics on defensive impact. In GSE, TOP informs state-transition models for defensive plays, updating defensive strength based on individual tackling efficiency.
layer2.telemetry: Player-level correlation between TOP and subsequent tackle success rates.

primitives.name: Yards Over Expected
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **MATH:** Defender influence ~ N2(μ = f(position, velocity, direction), Σ); count defenders exceeding a swarm threshold vs.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'YOE': 'Yards gained beyond expected (yards)', 'Y_{\\text{actual}}': 'Actual yards gained on the play', '\\hat{Y}_{\\text{expected}}': 'Random Forest-predicted expected yards given context'}
primitives.assumptions: Random Forest captures all relevant covariates, no systematic bias in expected yardage predictions, and stationary ball-carrier behavior.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breakdown happens when new offensive schemes create previously unseen contexts that invalidate the learned residual distribution.

layer2.mapping: Used in GSI for assessing receiver performance relative to expectation. In GSE, YOE drives tactical adjustments by quantifying how much a play exceeded baseline efficiency.
layer2.telemetry: Correlation between YOE and receiver catch probability in held-out data.

primitives.verbatim_quote: The adversarial pass overturned 3 of 5 — the pattern it caught: the first pass "adapted on concept name rather than on whether the information source survives the production downgrade." - Notebooks 6–12 carry first-pass verdicts only (no adversarial review) — flagged as such.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'PPPI': 'Probability of quarterback pressure (dimensionless)', 'P(\\text{QB pressure} \\mid \\text{pre-snap state})': 'Classifier score for pressure given alignment and movement features'}
primitives.assumptions: Independence of pre-snap features, stationary pressure generation mechanisms, and sufficient sampling of rare pressure events.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Complete failure occurs during meta-shifts where offensive formations drastically change the relationship between pre-snap cues and post-snap outcomes.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's game-state conditioning for pressure probabilities. In GSE, PPPI informs state-transition matrices for defensive blitz packages, adjusting transition rates based on pressure likelihood.
layer2.telemetry: Classification accuracy of PPPI on out-of-sample pre-snap frames.
